page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled, supported by dedicated CPU allocation. Hardware instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AES-NI, and BMI2. It includes 32 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. The instance provides no integrated local storage and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring remote block volumes for persistence.

Benchmark results indicate an asymmetric performance profile between single-threaded and multi-threaded execution. In single-core evaluation, the processor displays limited throughput, scoring 907 in Geekbench single-core and 1105.49 in stress-ng, placing it in the lower percentiles. Compression speeds reflect this constraint, with gzip single-threaded rates ranking in the bottom decile. Conversely, multi-threaded operations scale to average tiers, achieving a Geekbench multi-core score of 4895.0, a PassMark CPU score of 9929.97, and 8682.55 on stress-ng multi-core. Software compilation tasks in Clang reach 8900.0, while uncached memory bandwidth sustains 61.2 GB/sec read and 47.14 GB/sec write throughput. In-memory caching operations via Redis deliver 10.22 million operations per second, though synthetic database operations and static web serving tests measure in the lower 25th percentile.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the dedicated multi-core capacity and balanced memory footprint deliver moderate resource density without specialized accelerator costs. The absence of local NVMe storage and subdued single-thread speed make it unsuited for latency-sensitive transactional databases or intensive single-threaded processing. Instead, the instance aligns with parallelized batch workloads, background task processing, intermediate compilation pipelines, and containerized backend microservices that benefit from predictable multi-core scaling.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance equipped with 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it is paired with 32 GB of system memory, matching a balanced 1:4 resource ratio. The server features no bundled local storage and includes no discrete graphics processing units. Synthetic benchmarks demonstrate modest single-core throughput, evident in lower-tier Geekbench and compression scores, contrasted with stable, mid-tier multi-threaded execution across Geekbench multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Clang compilation metrics. Memory bandwidth reaches 61.2 GB/sec for uncached reads, while Redis SET operations sustain 10.22 million operations per second. With dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory provisioning, this configuration is technically suited for multi-threaded build systems, microservice backends, batch processing, and non-transactional application tier workloads that rely on distributed concurrent computing rather than peak single-thread execution.
